# Roasted Baby Potatoes

Crispy and simple.

## Ingredients
- Potatoes - 1 kg
- Olive oil - 2 tbsp
- Salt - 1 tsp

## Instructions
1. Gather all the ingredients before you start cooking.
2. Wash the potatoes thoroughly under running water.
3. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until golden and crisp.
